title: Invoice status without guesswork
description: Sending, the opening event where it is available, and payment are shown separately.

blocks.text: The person doing the work needs to know whether to ask about the document arriving or to discuss the payment date.

quote.text: My main reason for using this is all is because it would notify you of when clients open your estimates and invoices. Now it has stopped working so not worth it for me anymore

blocks.text: Show only the events that are known
Keep the sending, the opening event where it is available, and the payment, each with its own time. Allow a payment that arrived another way to be entered by hand, and the reminder to be stopped.

When the opening isn’t known, you can ask whether it arrived. When a partial payment is known, discuss the balance. It isn’t worth turning a missing mark into an accusation against the client, or promising to watch every possible way of reading.
